description: isSecretField: a declared credential is secret when the catalogue says so. An undeclared field is secret only when its name says it is.

cases.name: a credential name with a token in it is secret without a declaration
a password is secret without a declaration
a credentials name is secret without a declaration
a key word matches in any case
a plain name is not secret
a name that only contains letters of a key word is not secret
an unknown server falls back to the name alone
